Class SpotLight

java.lang.Object
lighting.Light
lighting.PointLight
lighting.SpotLight
All Implemented Interfaces:
LightSource
public class SpotLight extends PointLight
Represents a spotlight: a point light with a specific direction and beam. Intensity depends on both distance and the angle to the spotlight direction.
